name: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms (former Tang lands)
events: Abaoji, ruler (khagan) of the confederation of Khitans, proclaims himself emperor and establishes the Liao…
The Chu Kingdom is founded by the warlord Ma Yin (Prince of Chu) in Changsha.
The short-lived Wu Kingdom is founded by Yang Wo (Prince of Hongnong) in Jiangdu (South Central China).
Wang Jian becomes Emperor of China
Yang Wo becomes Emperor of China
Zhu Wen becomes Emperor of China
Yang Longyan becomes Emperor of China
